submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for Taoist chibi transport management game. Attached image1+2 STYLE ONLY: jade/teal, warm ivory, restrained gold, rounded cloud motifs, fine clean HD handpainted illustration, NOT UI frames or text. Image3 is world camera/art reference. Row3: willow drooping;chestnut domed;elm irregular round;cherry soft palecream blossoms. These are worldprops notUIicons. No gold frames, not bonsai in pots, tiny contactshadow only, all leaves and roots inside cell.
